title: The Part Sale parts table has a Priced by column too
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit' and 'Part Sales — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, pricing a new category made for this test, category A, with one range from $0.00: Default Markup % 50, tier A Markup % 20, and Separate Part Sale pricing off.
  • Have a new inventory part for this test, part A, in category A, cost $10.00, in a bin (for example E-11).
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, on tier A for Part Sales.
  • Have a new Part Sale for this test, Part Sale 1, for customer A, with part A added.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Part Sale 1.
  2. Point at part A's Priced by.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The parts table shows Priced by right after Sell Price.
  • Part A's Priced by reads tier A's name.

Step 2:

  • Part A's price details open, naming tier A and matrix A.
  • The matrix's side reads "Same as work orders", as matrix A has no separate Part Sale pricing.
